userspace_hid_300_second_check.note: Logged heartbeat gap is approximately one second and is not per-report HID age. Each admitted sample still requires a fresh full report within the 125 ms poll budget and 150 ms freshness gate.

observed_input.notes: The initial requested sequence was inconclusive. After reboot the operator swept the small thumbstick around its full circle twice and released it; both signs on both axes were observed. Explicitly confirmed physical neutral was near raw-normalized X -225. Final input calibration is separate from servo neutral and absolute limits.

limitations: BlueZ reported a connected link without HID reports; manual SYNC/reconnect restored streaming.
Physical sessions stop and retain the fault marker on input loss. Only the input-only monitor may reopen input.
No ready motion receipt was issued and no actuation was requested for this commissioning check.
Observed stick directions and input calibration do not establish collision-free physical neck motion.
Earlier stream checks failed; compatibility settings were changed together, so the radio failure root cause is not isolated.
A finite input-only qualification cannot guarantee future Bluetooth reliability.
